default.title: Shared short links and organized knowledge retrieval
default.summary: ClawPilot adds a user-scoped short-link service for ClawPilot and Eigen Racing, a structured Obsidian knowledge vault, verified AI Radar intake, and durable hybrid document-search infrastructure.
features: User-scoped short links with custom or generated slugs, tags, expiry, click limits, status controls, and destination or slug search
Canonical eigenracing.com short URLs with trusted server-to-server access for Eigen Racing applications
Portable Obsidian vault navigation that separates current contracts, release evidence, and historical notes
Official-source AI Radar updates in each user's generated research brief
Queued pgvector document embeddings with local hybrid retrieval by default and explicit, separately credentialed OpenAI semantic search when enabled
fixes: Made public short-link redirects bypass application sign-in while retaining API-level management authorization
Bound cross-application credentials to a declared source application and restricted production destinations to HTTPS
Added worker and migration visibility to hosted health checks
Added a read-only Railway backup audit that distinguishes logical checkpoints from provider snapshots
